title: Exploring the Term of the Auditor-Client Relationship and the Quality of Earnings: A Case for Mandatory Auditor Rotation?
sources_checked: Assigned paper and sample record: output/samples/records/W2152596199.json (p. 6 specifies Compustat fiscal firm-years 1988–2000, 2001 annual industrial/research vintage, six prior years, and 1988 start); output/models/records/W2152596199.json (Table 2 Panels A–C, pp. 13–14; Table 2 equation/control definitions, p. 12).

Accepted predecessor and results: output/reproductions/packages/W2152596199/attempt_04/outcome.json, build.sas, stata.ipynb, submission.json, and tables/table2_panelA.csv, table2_panelB_posCA.csv, table2_panelC.csv; native Stata DTA read with metadata only to confirm GVKEY string, FYEAR int16 annual fiscal label, CALYEAR int16, and outcome/control types. No old prepared observations were used for the pooled replay.

Current local COMP.FUNDA: ${ACCTREPL_SAS_ROOT}/comp/d_na/funda.sas7bdat; SAS metadata 941,340 rows/949 variables; DATA_DESCRIPTION catalog notes created 2026-07-20 and modified 2026-07-22. Bounded read selected the accepted INDL/C/D/STD population and exact construction fields; FY1987–2005 has 211,917 rows (FY2001–2005: 55,662), FY1988–2000 has 147,030, FY coverage is available through 2026, and FY2005 reporting dates run through 2006-05-31. Expected live field labels/types were confirmed, including GVKEY character, DATADATE SAS YYMMDDN8 date, FYEAR numeric fiscal label, CURCD character, and the required accounting/auditor/M&A proxy fields.

COMP.FUNDA uniqueness coverage check: within the accepted annual source filter and FY1980–2005, two duplicate GVKEY–FYEAR keys were found, one each in FY1982 and FY1983; there were no exact duplicate GVKEY–FYEAR–DATADATE records. There were no duplicate GVKEY–FYEAR keys in FY1987–2005. The accepted build resolves annual duplicates by sorting and keeping the latest DATADATE; that rule was retained. FY2001–2005 currency counts were USD 48,953 and CAD 6,709.

Current local COMP.G_EXRT_DLY: ${ACCTREPL_SAS_ROOT}/comp/d_global/currency/g_exrt_dly.sas7bdat; SAS metadata 2,221,564 rows/5 variables, catalog modified 2026-08-14; source date range 1982-02-01 to 2026-07-19. Under the accepted USD/CAD and 1987-01-01–2006-12-31 bounds, all 14,610 candidate rows are GBP-primary with positive rates and unique GBP currency-date keys. All 211,917 accepted-filter annual USD/CAD reporting dates in FY1987–2005 match a positive exact-date GBP-primary daily rate.

Current local COMP.G_EXRT_MTH: ${ACCTREPL_SAS_ROOT}/comp/d_global/currency/g_exrt_mth.sas7bdat; SAS metadata 75,838 rows/22 variables, catalog modified 2026-08-14; source date range 1982-01-31 to 2026-07-31. Under accepted USD/CAD and 1987-01-01–2006-12-31 bounds, all 480 candidate rows are GBP-primary with positive rates and unique GBP currency-date keys. All 211,917 accepted-filter annual USD/CAD reporting dates in FY1987–2005 match a positive exact-date GBP-primary 12-month rate.

Current SAS resource catalog: PROC CONTENTS source catalog, PROC CONTENTS entries for COMP.FUNDA, COMP.G_EXRT_DLY, and COMP.G_EXRT_MTH. The catalog JSON path referenced by the prior feasibility record was not present in the checked repository tree; source checks used this live local catalog and bounded reads of the exact named data files.

Fresh one-time controller receipt: work/runtime/20261118T073819188535Z/execution.json and latest.json; SAS build and Stata handoff both completed successfully, with 37,476 pooled DTA rows and isid gvkey fyear. Current DTA metadata confirms GVKEY string, FYEAR/CALYEAR numeric %10.0g, outcome variables double, controls and FE fields present; the prior DTA was read metadata-only and not reused.

Fresh aggregate native evidence: work/tables/table2_panelA.csv and work/tables/table2_panelC.csv, each produced by the current controller run; EXT_SAMPLE counts are in the corresponding job-local Stata logs cited on the successful rows. No aggregate table was produced for the failed positive-CA model.
changes: Extended the pooled estimation sample from fiscal years 1988–2000 to FY1988–2005, preserving the original start and 2000 as the omitted calendar-year fixed-effect category. The SAS preparation retains FY1987 as the t−1 source year, expands the daily and monthly FX source bounds through 2006-12-31 for FY2005 reporting dates, and extends annual Jones fits, annual outlier trimming, and final screens through FY2005.

Retained FYEAR in the SAS handoff and added computed e(sample) counts by FYEAR to each Stata fit, with the last actual estimation FY printed as EXT_SAMPLE. Count unit is one GVKEY–FYEAR firm-year; CALYEAR remains the accepted year(datadate) calendar-year fixed-effect variable.

Corrected the copied Stata notebook adopath to the published reconstruction ado directory after relocation into this job. The SAS-to-Stata architecture, accepted latest-DATADATE duplicate resolution, model terms, fixed effects, estimator/inference, transformations, and screens were retained.

The controller’s single native execution built a 37,476-row pooled final common sample (FY1988–FY2005); 27,414 rows contribute in the original period and 10,062 in FY2001–FY2005 for each successful OLS scope. The source build reports zero duplicate final GVKEY–FYEAR keys and complete exact-date FX matches for all 211,917 FY1987–FY2005 source rows.
limitations: The paper used the 2001 Compustat annual industrial and research files. The local source is the current merged COMP.FUNDA vintage; local fiscal-year presence and exact field labels do not verify historical population equivalence or complete coverage of the paper-era universe.

The paper’s M&A exclusion uses Compustat footnote codes whose exact fields and values are not identified in the assigned source. The accepted construction retains its best-effort nonzero acquisition/merger financial-item proxy; records with all six fields missing cannot be classified as no M&A.
The local CHE label is Cash and Short-Term Investments, while the paper describes cash and cash equivalents; this semantic mismatch remains.
The paper does not identify the annual percentile algorithm or the covariance estimator. The accepted SAS default percentile procedure and model-based OLS/maximum-likelihood inference remain.

Auditor codes 0 (unaudited) and 9 (other) do not identify a specific auditor and remain excluded from auditor tenure/relationship screens. Auditor merger normalization follows the accepted documented mapping, but the paper does not specify every year-specific Big N membership list.

Auditor spells remain left- or right-censored at the local COMP.FUNDA history boundaries; missing auditor codes and fiscal-year gaps break spells. Current post-2005 observations aid the accepted five-year relationship screen, but the local source does not establish complete issuer-auditor histories or histories after its FY2026 endpoint.

The accepted conversion uses source-reported COMP.FUNDA CURCD and exact-date GBP-primary daily/monthly FX cross-rates. The preflight confirms required rates through the FY2005 observation dates. A matched daily rate has a blank EXRATTPD code; its positive value is unique, but the subtype is undocumented.
The M&A proxy uses nonzero financial fields rather than the paper’s unavailable footnote codes; rows with all six fields missing are not evidence of no M&A.
Table 2 has no CRSP market-value input or fixed-dollar screening threshold; Table 1 MVE descriptives are outside the assigned scopes.

The accepted 1980–2005 source audit found two duplicate GVKEY–FYEAR keys in FY1982 and FY1983 (within the early history screen), with no duplicate exact-date keys. The frozen construction’s latest-DATADATE selection resolves them. There were no duplicate firm-year keys in the target/lag data years FY1987–FY2005.

The exact local FX sources and their calendar-date coverage support the requested FY2005 extension, but this does not establish complete source-population coverage or remove the inherited construction and measurement limitations.

The assignment marks positive-DA, negative-DA, and negative-CA as not previously worked. Their attempt_04 native logs document r(430) failures without valid results; the accepted submission.json has null cell/table mappings, so these scopes were not launched in the current controller run. This inherited disposition and the failed attempts are both retained.
